faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the District Social Welfare Office Tirupathur (DSWO Tirupathur) for filling up vacant government positions in Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post being recruited under DSWO Tirupathur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive is being conducted to fill the Case Worker position under advertisement number 441/A1/2020.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in DSWO Tirupathur Case Worker Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Case Worker position in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for DSWO Tirupathur Case Worker Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The applications for this recruitment must be submitted strictly through offline mode by downloading the form and sending it via post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed offline application form for the Case Worker position is 23 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualifications are required for the Case Worker post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor of Social Work, Master of Social Work, B.Sc Psychology, M.Sc Psychology, Counselling Psychology, or Development Management.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for DSWO Tirupathur Case Worker Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category, including General, OBC, SC, and ST candidates, as the fee is Nil.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for DSWO Tirupathur Case Worker posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the recruited candidates will involve a thorough Document Verification stage as specified by the authority.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the official notification PDF and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification and application form from the official website at www.tirupathur.nic.in before the closing date.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type and location for this DSWO Tirupathur recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contractual government job opportunity based in Tirupathur, Tamil Nadu with the pincode 635601.
